subject: Post-demo: buying committee recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@finovatech.com>, Marta Silva <marta.silva@finovatech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-14T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: buying committee recap & next steps

Hi Daniel / Marta --

Thanks again for your time on today's demo. Quick recap and next steps so we're all aligned:  

Attendees we captured:
- Daniel Cho (PL - Product) -- Finovatech
- Marta Silva (IT Program Lead) -- Finovatech
- Lydia Park (CFO) -- economic buyer (mentioned)  
- Security: currently listed as "security@finovatech.com" for questionnaire follow-up

Key decision criteria (from the session):
1) Cost / unit economics (token pricing + deduping/caching impact)
2) Latency & SLO for summary/agent workloads (p95 target: <300ms)
3) Security & compliance (SOC 2, data residency, audit logs)
4) Deployment flexibility (hosted vs private/VPC options)
5) Support & SLA (runbook + escalation path)

Immediate asks / next steps:
- I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) with target milestones and owners. Please review and mark  any missing owners. Attachment: 20261114-finovatech-MAP.pdf / 20261114-finovatech-MAP.xlsx
- Daniel / Marta: can you confirm the primary procurement contact and estimated timeline? (Daniel, you mentioned EoY?)
- Security: if you can route the standard vendor questionnaire to security@finovatech.com, we'll prioritize the SOC 2 summary and architecture diagram.
- Proposed next meeting: 30-min follow-up with Lydia + procurement to align on budget & procurement path. Options: Nov 18 or Nov 20 - what works?

If helpful, I can produce a short pricing anchor and options pack for Lydia before the call.

Thanks -- I'll follow up with a calendar invite once we land a time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment(s): 20261114-finovatech-MAP.pdf, 20261114-finovatech-MAP.xlsx

From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@finovatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Silva <marta.silva@finovatech.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-14T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa -- great session. A few clarifications from our side:
- Confirmed: Lydia Park (CFO) is the economic buyer and will want a pricing anchor and clear run-rate projection.
- Procurement timeline: we're targeting contract signed by the end of December; procurement will do an initial review next week.
- Security: I'll route the questionnaire to our security team (security@finovatech.com). They'll likely ask for SOC 2 and details on data retention / audit logs.

Quick asks for your prep: can you send a 1-pager SOC 2 summary + high-level architecture diagram? Also a short price band (conservative / expected / aggressive) so Lydia has something to evaluate.

I'll confirm availability for Lydia on Nov 18/20 once I sync with her calendar.

Thanks,
Daniel
Product Lead, Finovatech

Date: 2026-11-15T11:00:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Finovatech next steps & ask for SOC2/eng support

Team -- quick internal note following the demo and external follow-up:  

Context: Finovatech (CFO = Lydia Park) looking for pricing anchor and SOC 2 summary. Procurement is aiming for EoY signature. They flagged security questions first; this is likely to be the gating item.

Asks:
- Aditya: can you pull the short SOC 2 one-pager + arch diagram and confirm we can share the redacted report? I attached the drive link in the external follow-up. Need by EOD Nov 15 so I can send to their team.
- Vivek: can you prepare a 1-slide perf SLO summary (p50/p95 numbers on our hosted vs dedicated templates) and a sentence on fallback behavior under load?
- Rishi/Laura: pricing anchor -- I'll draft a conservative/expected/aggressive band; would appreciate a quick sanity check before I send to Lydia.

Notes on positioning: emphasize hosted API for quick proof-of-concept, with Dedicated/VPC as a contract add-on for procurement comfort. Highlight cost controls (batching, caching) and observability (token-level cost breakdown).

I'll wait for SOC2 asset and perf slide, then send the Lydia invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
